$comment: Placeholders that would reach code: a combined shell flag, a launcher, an interpreter without a script file, and sed, awk or Windows PowerShell even after a file (they take code or options from any position: GNU sed reads "-ee <command>" as an option). Every one is refused before anything runs; the plain node script operation passes.

sh-lc.description: a job through a login shell

bash-ec.description: a job through bash with -e and -c combined

env-sh.description: a job through env and a shell

deno-eval.description: a job through a code subcommand

sed-file.description: a job line through sed with an input file first

awk-file.description: a job line through awk with a program-looking file first

powershell-file.description: a job through Windows PowerShell with a script first

node-script.description: the job by id through a script file
